description: Work out the most tax-efficient mix of salary and dividends for a UK limited company director from the company's profit, against taking it all as salary. An estimate for the current UK tax year. Needs no account.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

has_employment_allowance.description: True if the company has other employees and can claim the Employment Allowance.

other_income.description: Other personal income for the year, in pounds, if any.

profit.description: Company profit before tax, in pounds.

name: compare_salary_dividends
title: Compare Salary And Dividends
